doc: Background tasks: started with a handle at once, their progress and end readable, cancelled without waiting, the interface running all along.

tools.name: task.list
tools.description: The background tasks, newest first: each one's id, what it is, who started it, its state (running, done, failed, cancelled), its progress and how long it has run

all.description: the ended ones too (default: running and the last ten ended)

tools.name: task.status
tools.description: One task: its state, progress (0…1, and what it is doing), and once ended its result or why it failed

tools.name: task.cancel
tools.description: Cancels a task: taken at once (it answers without waiting for the work to stop), nothing the task would have committed is, and the work is asked to stop
tools.undo: none needed: nothing it would have made was kept; start it again
